title: Event contract gateway and adaptive format negotiation for SDK/CLI/API telemetry
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design and implement an Event Contract Gateway that negotiates telemetry payload formats across SDK, CLI, and API clients. Goal: accept multiple schema versions, normalize at the gateway, emit stable canonical events to downstream analytics pipelines, and provide a lightweight migration path for older clients without requiring immediate SDK/CLI upgrades.
acceptance_criteria: Gateway accepts v1/v2/v2.1 envelopes and emits canonical v2.1 events to ingestion topics
SDK and CLI use header-based capability negotiation; no client crashes for unknown fields
Automated validation harness flags incompatible payloads and returns actionable error payloads to clients
End-to-end sampling and replay verifies that query dashboards (Console) produce identical metrics before/after normalization for 95% of signals
Feature flag rollout: gateway negotiation enabled for 10% canary, 50% staged, then global rollout with automatic fallback rules
decisions: Use header 'X-Telemetry-Format' to advertise client schema versions instead of embedding version inside payload to keep SDK changes minimal
Normalize to canonical event model (v2.1) at gateway; downstream pipelines and dashboards consume canonical form
Implement a negotiation policy table mapping client capabilities to transformer chains; store policy as config in Console with rollout controls
Reject only when required fields are missing for configured customers (customer_impact high) otherwise convert best-effort and tag event as 'compatibility:best-effort'
progress_updates: 2025-02-10: Ticket created; scoping meeting with Product and Observability teams. Agreed on canonical schema v2.1 target.
2025-02-12: Prototype reverse-proxy with staged transformer (Go) that rewrites v1 field 'user_id' -> 'actor.id'. Integration tests cover 60% of mappings.

2025-02-15: Added capability negotiation header design; rafters: SDK team to accept header with minimal changes. Draft PR for gateway transformer posted: github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry-gateway/pull/412

2025-02-18: Ran initial canary with internal traffic (10%). Observed 0.4% increase in processing latency (p95 +12ms) — within budget. Logged two unexpected nested-field cases; filed ENG-33478 to handle nested arrays.
Planned 2025-02-20: Kick off SDK/CLI compatibility changes, update docs, and start public canary
review_comments: PM review: Ensure error messages contain migration hints and link to 'Telemetry migration playbook' in docs.
Design review: Keep envelope size increase < 1% for common events; avoid adding large optional metadata by default.
Security: Verified that header negotiation cannot be abused to bypass RBAC; requested threat model doc (attached to PR).
